learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn how to be Earth Heroes by protecting our forests, cleaning our oceans, and keeping our planet beautiful for everyone!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The Earth is the only home we have! It provides fresh air to breathe, clean water to drink, and healthy soil to grow all our yummy food.
Sometimes, dirty smoke from factories and plastic garbage thrown in rivers make the Earth sick. This is called pollution, and it hurts humans, plants, and animals.
We can save the Earth by remembering three magic words: Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle! We should use less plastic, use things again, and turn old paper into new paper.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Trash to Treasure!
fun_activity.instructions: Find an empty plastic water bottle or a cardboard box and use your crayons and imagination to turn it into a beautiful pencil holder or a bird feeder!

quick_recap: ⭐ Earth is a precious shared home for all humans, plants, and amazing animals.
⭐ Pollution harms our beautiful nature, so we must never litter or waste water.
⭐ Using the 3 Rs of Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle helps keep our planet clean and green.
